Achliya Aba 689/2020 - 1- In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad Anticipatory Bail Application No.689/2020 Afroz Khan s/o Zahed Khan Pathan, age 45 yrs., occu.business, r/o New Abadi, Nanded Road, Kalamnuri, Tq.Kalamnuri Dist.Hingoli. ...Applicant.. (Org.accused) Versus The State of Maharashtra, through Police Station, Kalamnuri. Dist.Hingoli. Respondent.. ..... Shri H.I. Pathan, Advocate for applicant. Shri R.V. Dasalkar, App for the State. ..... Coram: V.L. Achliya, J. Date: 11.09.2020 Per Court : 1] On an apprehension of arrest in relation to ofences registered u/s 188, 272, 273 & 328 of the Indian Penal Code registered vide Crime No.260/2020 with Police Station, Kalamnuri Dist.Hingoli, the applicant has preferred this application seeking Afroz Khan S/O. Zahed Khan Pathan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 11 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130922898/ 1 anticipatory bail.
texts.facts: ] By referring the overall facts of the case and accusations made against the applicant, the learned counsel submits that as per the prosecution case, raid was conducted on 27.7.2020 in the shop and godown located near Bus Stand, Kalamnuri Dist.Hingoli belonging to Afroz Pathan - present applicant on information that the contraband articles like scented tobacco, Gutkha, Pan Masala of brand name Vimal, Goa and Pan Parag were stored in the shop for sale. While conducting raid, the person by name Shaikh Musabir Shaikh Shabbir was present in the shop. In the search made in the shop, huge quantity of contraband articles were seized. The shop was belonging to the applicant. 4] It is submitted that the applicant is not the owner of the shop. There is no evidence to show that the premises where the raid was conducted was owned and belonged to applicant. It i submitted that even if the allegations in the First Information Report are accepted in their entirety, still they make out no ofence u/s 328 of the Indian Penal Code.
texts.arguments: By referring the Division Bench decision of this Court in the case of Anand Ramdhani Chaurasia & another v. State of Maharashtra & others (2019 DGLS (Bom.) 1020), the Afroz Khan S/O. Zahed Khan Pathan vs The State Of Maharashtra on 11 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/130922898/ 2 learned counsel submits that this Court has held that the storage of prohibited substance as that of articles seized do not fall within the purview of ofence u/s 328 of the Indian Penal Code. 5] On the other hand, learned APP opposed the application with contention that huge quantity of contraband articles were seized during the raid conducted in the shop premises belonging to applicant. It is submitted that in the State of Maharashtra, by virtue of the orders issued under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, sale, possession and consumption of Gutkha and Pan Parag is prohibited. In contravention of the prohibitory orders in force, the applicant is found to have stored huge quantity of contraband articles for sale.
